brief_bounded_evidence_summary: Canastota, NY (2023-2024): conditional_example_ready safety/non-safety comparison structure with preserved lineage.
caveats: The police value is specifically the Year 1 entry step for officers hired after 1999, while the Code Enforcement Officer line provides a single listed rate with no tenure, step, or experience label. The source establishes common municipality, cycle, page, hourly pay basis, and schedule-listed wage status, but it does not establish comparable tenure, experience, duties, qualifications, hours, full-time status, or schedule position. The upstream normalized Code Enforcement Officer record was incorrectly tagged as police; this validation corrects the candidate interpretation from the verbatim source line but does not overwrite the raw upstream record. The negative $0.91/hour documentary difference pertains only to these two specifically listed schedule values and must not be generalized to police and non-safety employees in Canastota. This is bounded local documentary evidence, not a final wage-gap estimate, and is not nationally representative. Substantive/manual validation of occupational and schedule-position comparability is required before analytic use beyond a qualified supporting example.
